## Summary
Full-stack and machine learning engineer with hands-on experience building end-to-end systems using Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, and PyTorch. Comfortable owning both frontend and backend—from neural network formulation and async task processing to real-time WebSocket communication and production UI design.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deep Learning & RL**: PyTorch, GBML-DQN, YOLOv11 Computer Vision, Custom Feedforward Architectures, Fraud Detection.
- **Autonomous Agents**: Local LLM Orchestration (Qwen3 via Ollama), Tool Calling & Chaining, OS-Level Automation.
- **Real-Time & Distributed Systems**: WebSockets, Async Task Processing (Redis & Celery), Python FastAPI Microservices.
- **Modern Full-Stack**: Next.js (App Router, SSR), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GPU Motion & Canvas Shaders.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS (EC2, S3), Docker Containerization, Git & CI/CD Pipelines.

## Featured Engineering Projects
- **Smart Traffic Management System Using YOLOv11 and GBML DQN**: Trained a Deep-Q-Network agent using YOLOv11 computer vision in SUMO simulation, reducing average queue length by ~36% across 600 episodes.
  - Repo: https://github.com/sedhehe/Smart_Traffic_Management_System_Using_YOLOv11_and_GBML_DQN
- **SED (System Execution Dashboard)**: Built a local AI-powered laptop automation agent using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, and TypeScript with real-time WebSocket communication, local LLM tool chaining (Qwen3 via Ollama), and Celery/Redis async task queues.
- **PXP-FraudNet**: Architected a 3-layer neural network for payment transaction fraud detection (94% accuracy, <1% FPR), coupled with a real-time React visualization dashboard.
- **XTree**: Developed a Chrome extension in JavaScript for automated webpage scraping and CSV export, cutting manual data collection time from 10 minutes to under 5 seconds.
  - Repo: https://github.com/sedhehe/XTree
